hook: Two women trapped under a sea cliff, with surf pounding the rocks.
narration: Two women were trapped under a sea cliff, in pounding surf.
This was Anacapa Island, off the coast of Southern California.
Two kayaks lay on the rocks beside them, under a wall of stone.
A Coast Guard Dolphin helicopter crew lowered a rescue swimmer into the white water.
He hauled one woman out through the breaking waves.
Swimmers wait for a gap between sets, so the next wave can't throw them into the rocks.
[short pause] Then the helicopter lifted them clear of the cliff on its hoist cable.
outcome: The swimmer hoisted both women, and the crew flew them back to Base Mugu.
title: Trapped under a sea cliff in the surf
description:
A Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin crew from Forward Operating Base Mugu lowered a rescue swimmer into the surf at Anacapa Island, California, and hoisted two stranded women on Aug. 11, 2020.

Footage: Official U.S. Coast Guard video, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/762991/coast-guard-rescues-two-females-stranded-anacapa-island
